sites.name: Duc Thanh School
sites.event: The place where teacher Nguyen Tat Thanh (President Ho Chi Minh) taught in 1910 before leaving to find a way to save the country.

sites.name: Po Sah Inu Cham Towers (Poshanu)
sites.event: The remaining architectural complex of ancient Cham Pa towers, dedicated to the worship of Shiva and Princess Poshanu.

sites.name: Ke Ga Lighthouse
sites.event: The oldest lighthouse in Vietnam and Southeast Asia, designed and built by the French using granite since 1897.

sites.name: Thay Thim Palace
sites.event: A national artistic and architectural relic, associated with the legend of the benevolence of the Taoist couple Thay Thim.

sites.name: Lau Ong Hoang
sites.event: The ruins of an ancient villa, associated with the love story between poet Han Mac Tu and Mong Cam.

sites.name: Ta Cu Mountain Pagoda (Linh Son Truong Tho)
sites.event: Famous for its 49m-long statue of Shakyamuni Buddha entering Nirvana, which once held the record for the longest reclining Buddha statue in Vietnam.

sites.name: Mui Ne Flying Sand Dunes (Red Sand Dunes)
sites.event: The stretching sand dunes that constantly change shape with the wind direction, a tourism symbol of Binh Thuan.

sites.name: Bau Trang (Bau Sen)
sites.event: A natural freshwater lake located amidst vast white sand dunes, likened to a 'mini Sahara desert'.

sites.name: Co Thach Stone Beach (Seven-Color Stone Beach)
sites.event: Famous for its multi-colored pebble beach and rocks covered in green moss every March.

sites.name: Cu Lao Cau (Hon Cau)
sites.event: A marine life conservation area with a rich coral system and pristine beaches.

sites.name: Phu Quy Island
sites.event: An outpost island with majestic landscapes, sheer cliffs, and ancient coastal pagodas.

place.commune: Long Hai, Ngu Phung, and Tam Thanh Communes

sites.name: Fairy Stream
sites.event: A small stream winding through brilliant red sand formations, creating a fairyland-like landscape.

place.commune: Mui Ne Ward (and Ham Tien Ward)
